reviews.review: This app!!! So simple to use and yet so powerful! I have struggled for years to keep up with my med schedule on my own (manually). reviews.review: I really like this app. I can check my medications and if I took one already so I don’t accidentally overdose. reviews.review: My daughter and I take lots of medication. The one thing we struggle with is calling in refills on time. Some times we have more medicine than we need and sometimes we have less. reviews.review: Firstly, this app is loaded with features. No complaints there. However, it's a bit bogged down for the average user.
